fundamental.summary: TJX shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, imminent earnings in 97 days, and complete absence of government contracts and lobbying activity.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal for TJX; mixed congressional activity (small amounts, junior members), neutral market fear/greed, and unavailable news data provide insufficient conviction for directional bias.
